$schema_note: Enemy-side entity tier stat blocks (task-002), closing the 'still open' item in SYSTEMS.md §1. Fodder/Soldier are Mass Entity; Elite/Titan/Boss are promoted Actors (GDD §10). Friendly retinue tiers (Freed/Militia/Veteran/Bannerman) are NOT duplicated here — they are owned by docs/data/upgrades.json; this file only adds the Armor column concept those rows can adopt later. Decisions + rationale: docs/design/entity-tiers.md. Columns/units/ranges: entity-tiers.schema.md. All values PROTOTYPE DIALS, unmeasured in-engine (docs/design/entity-tiers.md §7).

design_constants.swing_interval_shared_note: Shared cadence for Fodder/Soldier tiers and every existing retinue attacker (Swarm.SwingInterval default). Elite/Titan/Boss get their own longer SwingInterval (see per-tier rows) for telegraph legibility; it does not change their steady-state DPS (Blow = DPS x SwingInterval, same identity as the shipped model).
design_constants.armor_chip_floor_note: Swarm.ArmorChipFloor (proposed CVar). Minimum damage a blow always deals regardless of Armor: EffectiveBlow = max(AttackerBlow - VictimArmor, ArmorChipFloor). Guarantees no unit is ever literally unkillable by a lone attacker (GDD §7 soft-costs-over-hard-caps), just very slow to kill.
design_constants.reference_blow_note: RefBlow used by the EffectiveHP conversion (docs/design/entity-tiers.md §2.3) = Militia DPS(30) x SwingInterval(0.9). Militia is 'the balance anchor' per SYSTEMS.md §1, so it is the natural reference attacker for a single system-wide toughness figure.

tiers.Name: brood_fodder
tiers.TelegraphWindup: none — shared 0.35xSwingInterval strike point, individually weak, danger is numbers not a single blow
tiers.Notes: SHIPPED, UNCHANGED. Swarm.BroodMaxHP/BroodDPS/BroodTargetsPerHit in SwarmCombatProcessors.cpp. Documented here, not redesigned, to give the taxonomy a complete row. Working ID only — narrative has not named the faction (FLAME-FOUNDATION.md).

tiers.Name: brood_soldier_melee
tiers.TelegraphWindup: none — reads as 'a tougher, harder-hitting Brood', not a new threat class
tiers.Notes: NEW. Same MeleeRange/cadence as Fodder (shares the shared grid + victim-pull path, no new query shape). Armor is the load-bearing addition, not raw HP/DPS bloat: 6 flat points is small in absolute terms but crosses SoldierMaxHP's feed-duration clamp threshold on its own (see entity-tiers.md §2.3). Single-target (TargetsPerHit 1) — the step up from Fodder is durability + bite, not cleave.

tiers.Name: brood_soldier_ranged
tiers.Notes: NEW. Deliberately zero Armor — a glass ranged threat, mirrors the retinue's own Archers pattern (unit-types.json). EngageRange 700 is intentionally shorter than the retinue Archers' 750, so a retinue ranged line already out-ranges it (a stated, deliberate asymmetry favoring the player's own ranged investment). MinEngageRange 150 reuses the Archers 'won't shoot into its own scrum' approximation (unit-types.json ranged_combat_model).

tiers.Name: brood_elite
tiers.TelegraphWindup: 1.8s SwingInterval, strike at ~0.35 fraction (~0.63s in) — long relative to the shared 0.9s cadence so the AoE swing reads as a distinct, dodgeable beat at horde scale
tiers.Notes: NEW. First tier where Armor is load-bearing: cuts Freed/base-Archer blows by ~1/3-2/3, barely dents Veteran/Hero blows (entity-tiers.md §2.2 table) — punishes cheap/numerous recruits, rewards Promote-lane investment. TargetsPerHit 5 (AoE) punishes the retinue for clustering on it, symmetric to what its Armor already does to the retinue's cheap attackers.

tiers.Name: brood_titan
tiers.TelegraphWindup: 2.5s SwingInterval, long dramatic windup — screen-filling AoE stomp, must be readable at 500-unit density (Design Law 6)
tiers.Notes: NEW, NOT built in the 3-floor vertical slice roster (RTS-VERTICAL-SLICE.md §5 lists no titan) -- specced here only to complete the SYSTEMS.md §1 taxonomy for later floors/content. Armor 20 floor-clamps Freed and base-Archer blows entirely (chip-floor territory) and still halves Veteran/Hero blows -- an exponential-curve gatekeeper (Design Law 1): a thin or under-promoted army makes no real progress against it. Slow move speed (0.5x) is the stated counterplay -- kiteable by a mobile hero/retinue rather than a DPS check.

tiers.Name: brood_boss
tiers.TelegraphWindup: 2.0s baseline SwingInterval; per-phase mechanic telegraphs are OUT OF SCOPE here (Boss & elite design is a separate deliverable)
tiers.Notes: BASELINE STAT BLOCK ONLY -- full phase/arena/mechanic design belongs to the separate 'Boss & elite design' scope area, not this doc. Armor deliberately LOWER than Titan's despite ~2x the HP: RTS-VERTICAL-SLICE.md §5 states the boss is 'positioning + stances, not a DPS check' -- its toughness should read as HP/phases/adds, not as an armor wall the way Titan's identity works. TargetsPerHit 6 sits between Elite(5) and Titan(8).
